title: AI agent callers
subtitle: Handle consumer AI assistants that phone you for prices and availability, safely and from your own price book.
honesty: A caller is only treated as an AI agent when it says so. Caller ID and phone numbers are never used to guess. When Vireek is unsure, it behaves exactly as it does for a human caller.

overview.winRateHint: Confirmed jobs divided by calls, same definition for both groups.
overview.platforms: Where they say they come from
overview.emptyHint: When an AI assistant calls and says it is one, it appears here with its quote, hold and outcome.
overview.disabledBanner: AI agent handling is off. Callers are treated as humans. Turn it on in Controls.

holds.expiringBody: {{count}} hold(s) expire within 15 minutes and are released automatically if nobody approves them.
holds.emptyHint: Holds appear here when an AI assistant reserves one of your open times.
holds.alreadyDone: That hold was already handled or has expired

settings.enabledHint: Off by default. When off, every caller is treated as a human.
settings.approvalMode: When an agent picks a time
settings.mode_quote_only: Quote only, never hold a time
settings.mode_hold_for_approval: Hold the time and ask me to approve
settings.autoBookWarn: Automatic booking confirms a job without a person looking at it. Only choose it if you are happy to honour every booking.
settings.flatPriceMode: How a flat price is spoken
settings.blockedZips: ZIP codes you never serve to AI agents
settings.neverDiscuss: Topics never discussed with AI agents
settings.neverDiscussHint: One word or phrase per line, for example warranty or discount. The agent is told a team member will follow up.
settings.allowSms: Send the written summary by text
settings.allowEmail: Send the written summary by email
settings.maxServicesCaller: Different services per caller per day
settings.maxQuotesHour: Quotes per hour for the whole business
settings.emergencyNote: Emergencies always win: emergency wording goes to your normal emergency routing, never to a quote.
settings.ownerOnly: Only the account owner can change these controls.

services.intro: Choose which price book services an AI agent may be quoted by phone. Human callers are not affected.
